layman_headline: Market fear is intense — staying on the sidelines until the dust settles.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is gripped by extreme fear (25/100 and worsening), which means most traders are panicking. Bitcoin is holding around $64,000 but faces a critical test at the $63,000 support level. The candidates for a swing trade are either too beaten down with no clear bottom (LDO down 26% in a week), already overextended after huge rallies (BTW, PUMP), or lacking enough data to analyze properly. This is not the time to force a trade.
layman_action: Do nothing right now. Keep your cash ready. If Bitcoin holds $63,000 and fear starts to ease, better entry opportunities will appear in the next few days.
expert_reasoning: Fear & Greed at 25 with a worsening trend triggers Validated Rule #3: at 25 or below, the short-term outlook is genuinely ambiguous and the safest call is HOLD. Multiple swing candidates lack critical data — ETHFI, PUMP, MON, UB have no RSI, no MACD, no chart analysis, and no funding rates, meaning fewer than three core data sources are available for proper analysis (Rule #4 consideration). LDO is the most interesting candidate with a -25.8% weekly drop and 2.91x risk/reward to support/resistance, but RSI at 43 is neutral, not oversold, and the chart bias is -0.10 (neutral). BTW and PUMP have already run 44.7% and 26.2% respectively — chasing momentum in extreme fear environments is high-risk. The Treasury liquidity drain news from CryptoSlate adds a macro headwind for tomorrow. BTC dominance at 56.6% confirms capital is rotating out of alts into BTC, making alt entries especially dangerous right now.
risk_factors: Fear & Greed could deteriorate below 20, triggering further capitulation selling across alts
$77B Treasury liquidity drain could push BTC below the critical $63,000 support, dragging the entire market lower
High BTC dominance (56.6%) means alts face disproportionate selling pressure even if BTC stabilizes
watch_list: Bitcoin's defense of $63,000 support — a break below could accelerate selling across all candidates
Fear & Greed Index trajectory over the next 48 hours — stabilization above 25 or recovery toward 30 would signal a potential entry window
LDO price action near $0.30 support — if it holds with rising RSI and volume, it becomes the top bounce candidate
market_context: Extreme Fear (25, worsening from 28 yesterday) dominates the market while BTC consolidates at $64K near the critical $63K battle zone flagged by Glassnode. A looming $77B Treasury liquidity drain adds macro pressure, and institutional stablecoin/tokenization news has not translated into risk-on sentiment.
context_banner: Extreme fear with worsening momentum and macro liquidity headwinds — discipline demands patience over action.

key_signals.description: Fear & Greed at 25 (Extreme Fear), down from 28 yesterday with a worsening weekly trend — triggers Rule #3 to HOLD rather than force entries in ambiguous conditions.
US Treasury quietly draining $77B from bank reserves tomorrow creates a near-term liquidity headwind that could pressure BTC below $63K support.
LDO RSI at 43 is neutral, not oversold — despite a 26% weekly drop, there's no RSI confirmation of a bottom, reducing confidence in a mean-reversion entry.
Glassnode identifies $63,000 as Bitcoin's key battleground — a break below would invalidate any alt-coin bounce thesis.
No volume confirmation on any candidate: BTW and PUMP ran on unclear volume, while beaten-down LDO and ETHFI show no accumulation signals.
